real_native_runs.private_test_fix: Unique ephemeral 127.0.0.1 interserver HTTP port, one-node posthog_migrations cluster, local Keeper raft, source-verified original tracking DDL

unit_safety_tests.test_scope: offline/mocked fail-closed safety, exact source blob, loopback-only HTTP, safe resource/owner refusal, no optimized-away assertions
unit_safety_tests.cross_platform_note: Source checkout attestation test skips on hosts without the owner-only Flind source. Safety mocks use platform-local TemporaryDirectory and run independent of owner path.

important_warning: Original migrate_clickhouse --plan/--check may CREATE database and tracking tables before displaying plan. Do not invoke against non-owner or shared databases. Offline Wave224 is source inventory only.
mutable_binary_caution: Self-extracting ClickHouse binary can mutate a runtime copy. Never hardlink compressed official source to executed runtime; copy only. Historical source asset was independently SHA verified; alternate earlier owner scratch binary had expanded and was rejected.
